{{Quote|Here is the location of Phor Cl-lan. He's the so-called Water Treatment Tech. Maybe a 'Champion' can squeeze some fresh water out of him...|A disgruntled townsperson, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TPAR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Peasants Are Revolting|Lok}}</ref>}}
'''Phor Cl-lan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I had to get away for a while from that broken-down piece of bantha... I mean, the Treatment Facility.|Phor Cl-lan, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:PIP" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Phor Cl-lan worked for the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] as the [[Water/Legends|water]] treatment technician of the city known as [[Nym's Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:PIP" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the water treatment facility that supplied the city in drinkable water got broken and was unable to correctly filtrate the water, pumped in the sulfur rivers of Lok. Unfortunately, Phor Cl-lan missed the parts required to repair the filtration system.<ref name="SWG:PIP" /> As such, the water provided to the inhabitants of Nym's Stronghold was contaminated with sulfur, causing the population to revolt against Nym. The warlord therefore tasked a loyal [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to deal with the situation.<ref name="SWG:TPAR" /> The spacer accepted to help Phor Cl-lan who needed several chemicals and parts to fix the water treatment facility, namely cationic chemical coagulant, flow control valves and a motor power regulator.<ref name="SWG:PIP" /> The spacer first obtained cationic chemical coagulant from the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Dak Vox]]<ref name="SWG:IWIA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|I Want It All|Lok}}</ref> and used to resupply the mixing chamber of the filtration system.<ref name="SWG:RtMC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Resupply the Mixing Chamber|Lok}}</ref> The spacer then found flow control valves from a pressurized liquid storage unit nearby and used to repair the sedimentation tank.<ref name="SWG:UP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Under Pressure|Lok}}</ref> Finally, the spacer acquired a motor power regulator from the [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] of the Lok Revenants [[Ralia Reeven]] and used it to fix the flocculation chamber.<ref name="SWG:RtFC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Repair the Flocculation Chamber|Lok}}</ref> Thanks to the efforts of the spacer, Phor Cl-lan was able to repair the treatment facility and provide clean water to the city and its inhabitants.<ref name="SWG:RwGN">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Return with Good News|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Phor Cl-lan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PIP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Phor Cl-lan was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:PIP" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
